reference_text: Good morning and welcome to Limbok Holdings Earnings Conference Call. Speaking today is CEO Mike McCann and CFO Jay Sharp. We are pleased to announce quarterly revenue of $135.2 million, expanding our gross margin to 24.5%. Owner direct revenue reached 62% of total revenue, generating free cash flow of $14.1 million. We will now open the line for analyst questions. First question comes from Rob Brown with Lake Street Capital Markets. Mike, could you provide more detail on owner direct revenue growth and customer retention? Owner direct relationships expanded to 62% of total revenue, driving higher gross margins. Our next question comes from Gary Sweeney with Roth MKM. How does the acquisition pipeline look for expanding specialized mechanical services? We continue to evaluate a creative tuck-in acquisitions that enhance our recurring maintenance profile. Our next question comes from Brent Theelman with DA Davidson. What is your outlook for data center and industrial project demand? from mission-critical facilities remains very healthy across our primary geographies.
